description: Download an arXiv paper's PDF to a local folder, named after the paper title. Accepts an arXiv ID (new-style 2601.00001, old-style hep-th/9901001, optional version suffix vN) or an abs/PDF URL; saves the PDF into --output (default: current directory) as "{sanitized title}.pdf". Returns the resolved id, title, absolute file path, and size in bytes. Requests are spaced >=3s per arXiv API policy. No authentication required.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: arXiv paper ID or abs/PDF URL. Accepted forms: new-style ID ("2601.00001"), new-style with version suffix ("2601.00001v2"), old-style ID ("hep-th/9901001"), old-style with version suffix ("hep-th/9901001v2"), abstract URL ("https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.00001"), or PDF URL ("https://arxiv.org/pdf/2601.00001"). The version suffix is passed through unchanged. IDs appear in results of arxiv/list-papers, arxiv/search, and arxiv/get-author-papers.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Local folder to save the PDF into (default: current working directory). Relative paths are resolved against the directory where the command is run; absolute paths are used as-is; the folder is created automatically if it does not exist. The file is named "{sanitized title}.pdf": filesystem-unsafe characters are replaced with underscores, Windows reserved device names are prefixed with an underscore, and the name is truncated to 200 characters.
